cells.rationale: The US has the largest and most diverse quantum ecosystem globally, with substantial government funding, numerous startups, and major tech companies driving both fundamental research and applied development in quantum communication (QKD, quantum networks) and sensing (quantum metrology, atomic clocks, gravimeters).

evidence: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) - Pan Jianwei's group
